items.title: CSTO incorporates Russian counter-drone experience into training
items.summary: CSTO Secretary-General Masadykov said Russian experience in countering unmanned aircraft is being incorporated into the training of the alliance's collective forces to strengthen their capabilities.

items.title: Russian military unit claims thousands of Ukrainian drone interceptions
items.summary: A Russian military-affiliated report claims the Rubicon centre has intercepted more than 11,000 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones in total, including nearly 6,000 during autumn 2026. The figures have not been independently verified.
